name: NightCafe
summary: A community-driven platform for generating artistic AI images.
description:
A community-driven platform for generating artistic AI images.

Text-to-Image Creation: Generates images from textual descriptions. Style Transfer: Applies artistic styles to existing images. Community Features: Engages users through challenges and sharing. Print Options: Offers printing of created artworks.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access NightCafe
